phrases.latin: Pater, cīnctūrā laxātā, puerum artē dormientem ex autoraedā tollēns
phrases.english: Dad, undoing the seat belt and lifting the sound-asleep boy out of the car
phrases.source: Libellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 313, checked against the searchable text of the book (29 October 2026).

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
